summary: The Medicare Low Income Subsidy Equality Act of 2026 amends titles XVIII and XIX of the Social Security Act to make premium and cost-sharing subsidies available to low-income Medicare part D beneficiaries who reside in Puerto Rico or other U.S. territories. It establishes rules for calculating these subsidies and related Medicaid assistance starting in January 2027.

affected_groups.effect: They become eligible for Medicare prescription drug premium and cost-sharing subsidies using the contiguous U.S. poverty line standard.
affected_groups.group: Low-income Medicare Part D beneficiaries residing in Puerto Rico and other U.S. territories

affected_groups.effect: Their federal medical assistance and funding limits under Medicaid (Section 1108(f) and Section 1935) are adjusted and increased beginning in fiscal year 2027.
affected_groups.group: State and territory governments (specifically Puerto Rico and other territories)

key_provisions: Makes premium and cost-sharing subsidies available to low-income Medicare Part D beneficiaries living in Puerto Rico and other U.S. territories.
Applies the poverty line for the 48 contiguous States and the District of Columbia to individuals residing outside of the 50 States or D.C. for subsidy eligibility.
Removes previous restrictions and exclusions that limited territory participation in these specific Medicare low-income subsidies.
Updates Medicaid assistance computations and funding amounts for Puerto Rico and other territories beginning with fiscal year 2027.
Sets effective dates for Medicare amendments to take effect on January 1, 2027, with Medicaid and other administrative amendments taking effect upon enactment.
missing_information: Exact dollar amounts or total budgetary costs associated with the new subsidies and funding increases.
Specific administrative rules the Secretary of Health and Human Services will use beyond the statutory formulas.
The precise list of all U.S. territories covered beyond Puerto Rico (though 'other territories of the United States' is mentioned).
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Medicare Low Income Subsidy Equality Act of 2026 amends titles XVIII and XIX of the Social Security Act to make premium and cost-sharing subsidies available to low-income Medicare part D beneficiaries who reside in Puerto Rico or other U.S. territories. It establishes rules for calculating these subsidies and related Medicaid assistance starting in January 2027.
summary_detail.significance: The bill extends federal Medicare prescription drug low-income subsidies to U.S. territories like Puerto Rico, altering how eligibility and funding are computed for these regions compared to prior law.
